DankiaSource.description:
Enumeration of Dankia data sources for electronic dispensary integration.

Available options:
  • DANKIA_DISP_ATEND_PACIENTE - Patient Attendance
  • DANKIA_DISP_BARRAS - Barcode
  • DANKIA_DISP_FUNCIONARIO - Employee
  • DANKIA_DISP_FUNC_ESTOQUE - Stock Employee
  • DANKIA_DISP_ITEM_TRANSF - Transfer Item
  • DANKIA_DISP_LOC_ESTOQUE - Stock Location
  • DANKIA_DISP_MATERIAL - Material
  • DANKIA_DISP_MAT_HOR - Material Prescription
  • DANKIA_DISP_PACIENTE - Patient
  • DANKIA_DISP_PADRAO_LOCAL - Standard Location
  • DANKIA_DISP_SALDO_LOCAL - Local Balance
  • DANKIA_DISP_SETOR - Department
  • DANKIA_DISP_TRANSACAO - Transaction
  • DANKIA_DISP_KIT_ESTOQUE - Stock Kit
  • DANKIA_DISP_KIT_EST_COMP - Stock Kit Component
  • REGRA_SUBSTITUICAO_DANKIA - Substitution Rule

DispensaryApplicationType.description:
Enumeration of electronic dispensary application types supported by the integration.

Available options:
  • DANKIA \- Dankia electronic dispensary application
  • PYXIS \- Pyxis electronic dispensary application

data.description: Payload of dispensary data to be inserted.

ElectronicDispensaryInsertVO.description: Data for inserting an electronic dispensary.

PyxisSource.description:
Enumeration of Pyxis data sources for electronic dispensary integration.

Available options:
  • INT_DISP_LANC_MATERIAL - Material Launch
  • INT_DISP_LANC_MATERIAL_INSERT - Material Launch Insert
  • INT_DISP_MAT_HOR - Material Schedule
  • INTDISP_PADRAO_LOCAL - Standard Location
  • INT_DISP_MOVT_PAC - Patient Movement
  • INT_DISP_REQ_MATERIAL - Material Request

code.description: Identifier code of the dispensary record.

ProcessDataVO.description: Processing data for an electronic dispensary.

ProcessType.description:
Enumeration representing the processing state of an electronic dispensary record, stored as a single character in the database.

Available options:
  • YES \- Record has been processed successfully (database value: S)
  • NO \- Record has not been processed yet (database value: N)
  • ERROR \- Record processing resulted in an error (database value: E)

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be returned.

ElectronicDispensaryRequestVO.description: Request data for querying electronic dispensaries.
